metadata.title: Pumpkin  and Pork | Wak Gominda
metadata.description:
Click to tweet and share this recipe: https://ctt.ec/8cNW6

An authentic and all time favorite Garo dish made of Pumpkin and pork. This delicious dish features very commonly on the Garo platter. It is delicious blend of sweet taste of ripe pumpkin and succulent meaty taste of pork.
